extracted.intended_audience: readers of literary criticism and moral/philosophical essays
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating the literary qualities and development of Maurice Maeterlinck's prose and drama (and, on the preceding pages, evaluating the practical testability and moral demands of a Christian ethic of universal love). Focuses on style, atmosphere, thematic aims, and authenticity of moral practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: True_happiness_is_present_love
rubrics_metrics.description: True happiness is love lived here and now rather than a future order imposed by violence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate moral or social programs by whether they open the possibility of immediate, lived love for oneself and others; anti-patterns are systems promising future salvation through violent reordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change_of_life_viewpoint_required
rubrics_metrics.description: A genuine change in one's life-view (reorienting life around love for all) is necessary and possible; continuing a life embittered against others is untenable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess authenticity by whether a proposed ethic requires a deep reorientation of aims and daily acts rather than cosmetic or rhetorical change; continuing hostilities indicates failure to adopt the principle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test_teachings_by_experiment
rubrics_metrics.description: Moral teachings (the doctrine of love) should be verified by an experimental practice: adopt the precepts for a set time and compare mental and practical effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical steps include refraining from retaliation, responding to wrong with good, not gossiping or condemning behind a person's back, treating even animals kindly. Compare mood, clarity, and effectiveness after one or more trial periods to judge applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: No_limits_on_true_charity
rubrics_metrics.description: True charity has no arbitrarily defined stopping-point; setting a border to benevolence indicates hypocrisy rather than genuine feeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating acts of charity ask whether recipients are treated according to a limitless sense of brotherhood. Examples illustrating the dilemma (loss of comfort, disease, resource scarcity) should not be taken as grounds for establishing a moral 'limit' if the original motive was authentic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reject_violence_to_fight_violence
rubrics_metrics.description: One must not fight violence with violence; using violent means to remove violent structures simply replaces one violence with another.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preferred methods are exposing violence, preaching love, and exemplifying sacrifice. When assessing political or social strategies, prioritize nonviolent methods that transform rather than reproduce coercion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total_self_sacrifice_for_authenticity
rubrics_metrics.description: To live the ethic of love authentically may require extreme self-sacrifice; failure to give up everything when called to do so is morally culpable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate personal and collective commitment by willingness to sustain sacrifices even when costly in health, comfort, or life; consider whether avoidance of sacrifice reflects cowardice or dishonesty about motives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invoke_silence_and_twilight
rubrics_metrics.description: A writer's strength can lie in discovering and invoking silence and twilight (hämärä) as moods that open the inner life and heighten perception.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess works by how effectively they create liminal, twilight atmospheres where everyday details recede and inward vision expands; use imagery of diminishing clear light and rising inner perception as a quality marker.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy_and_sparseness_of_expression
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of few words, minimally staged movements, and concentrated, tense atmosphere—sparse expression that makes each word and gesture weighty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge passages and plays by their economy: dialogue should be minimal yet loaded; stage movements or descriptive detail should be sharp, simple, and natural rather than ornamental. Anti-pattern: verbosity that dilutes tension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reveal_inner_life_through_everyday
rubrics_metrics.description: Under everyday words and commonplace actions there can be a hidden, more important life; the task is to hint at or reveal this interior reality through ordinary detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether ordinary scenes and objects are used to suggest deeper spiritual or psychological states. The more quotidian the vehicle and the more convincing the revelation, the stronger the effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use_simple_figures_to_express_depth
rubrics_metrics.description: Simple or marginalized figures—children, the blind, animals—can be employed to disclose profound, hidden truths about the soul.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess character choice and representation: does the use of naïve or limited-perspective figures illuminate rather than trivialize the theme? Examples: blind characters who sense death or children who sense mysteries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blend_mysticism_with_realism
rubrics_metrics.description: A successful author may reconcile mystic, metaphysical backgrounds with ordinary reality, so that the marvelous becomes palpable and the real acquires a radiance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge how well a work synthesizes opposing worlds (mysticism and daily life) without collapsing into mere sentimentality or abstruse abstraction. Look for credible links between interior revelation and external, sensory detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development_from_mystery_to_clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Artistic development may be measured by a shift from heavy preoccupation with death and obscure mystery toward greater clarity, lightness, and integration with living reality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating an author's oeuvre, note chronological movement: earlier works may be darker and more enigmatic, later works more luminous and reconciled with daily human concerns; this arc can be a mark of maturation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blend_science_and_mystical_insight
rubrics_metrics.description: Combining meticulous natural-scientific observation (e.g., bees, flowers) with mystical reflection can ground spiritual themes in tangible detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether empirical description enriches rather than undermines the mystical tone: careful observation can lend credibility and texture to symbolic or metaphysical claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value_silence_over_explicit_statement
rubrics_metrics.description: If one has something genuinely important to say, restraint and silence may be more powerful—souls touch best 'without the senses.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate the use of implication, omission, and silence as rhetorical devices; restraint that invites reader participation and interior resonance is preferred to explicit moralizing or exposition.
